component.name: AppGrid
component.summary: Browse, install, and update APT and Flatpak applications

description.p: AppGrid is a screenshot-grid software store for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Debian 12, and distributions based on those releases. Double-click this package in Files to open App Center, GNOME Software, or GDebi, then choose Install.
Search, install, and remove desktop apps from APT. Optional Flatpak support can be turned on later in Settings. System updates use the normal administrator password prompt.
